description: This file contains a JUnit test class 'NotePadProviderTest' which tests the content provider of the Note Pad sample Android application. It includes various test cases for URI handling, querying, inserting, updating, deleting, stream types, and data pipe operations related to notes stored in an SQLite database.

classes.name: NotePadProviderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the NotePadProvider content provider, including URI handling, CRUD operations, stream types, and data piping for note records.

classes.name: NoteInfo
classes.description: Helper class representing a note with content and metadata, used for setting up test data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment, initializes mock resolver and database, runs before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests, runs after each test.

methods.name: insertData
methods.description: Populates the database with predefined test notes.

methods.name: testUriAndGetType
methods.description: Verifies correct MIME types returned for various note URIs.

methods.name: testGetStreamTypes
methods.description: Checks stream MIME types for different URIs and filters.

methods.name: testOpenTypedAssetFile
methods.description: Tests opening asset file descriptors for notes with MIME type support.

methods.name: testWriteDataToPipe
methods.description: Verifies data written into pipe from note content matches expected note data.

methods.name: testQueriesOnNotesUri
methods.description: Tests querying the full notes dataset with various projections and criteria.

methods.name: testQueriesOnNoteIdUri
methods.description: Tests querying individual notes by ID via content URI.

methods.name: testInserts
methods.description: Tests inserting new notes into the provider and verifies correctness.

methods.name: testDeletes
methods.description: Tests deleting notes and verifying the deletions.

methods.name: testUpdates
methods.description: Tests updating note records and verifying the updates.
